title: Add persistent PDF download and reset functionality

requirements.summary: Display a 'Download PDF' button after checklist submission that allows manual PDF download
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Download PDF' button appears after successful checklist submission
Clicking the button triggers a PDF download
The button remains visible and functional after download

file_operations.description: Add state to track whether a PDF has been generated (e.g., isPdfReady boolean). After successful form submission, set this state to true. Conditionally render a 'Download PDF' button when isPdfReady is true. The button should call the existing pdfGenerator utility with the current form data (store name, checklist items, photos) and trigger a browser download. Style the button using the NeumorphicButton component to maintain the neumorphic design system.

requirements.summary: Keep the PDF download button visible and functional until the user clicks a Reset button
acceptanceCriteria: The Download PDF button persists after first download
User can click Download PDF multiple times without resubmitting
The button only disappears when Reset is clicked

file_operations.description: Ensure the isPdfReady state persists after the first download, allowing the Download PDF button to remain visible. The button should remain clickable and trigger a new PDF download each time using the current form data without requiring resubmission. Only clear the isPdfReady state when the Reset button is clicked (implemented in REQ-3).

requirements.summary: Add a 'Reset' button that clears the checklist, removes the PDF download button, and allows new submissions
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Reset' button is visible when the PDF download button is shown
Clicking Reset clears all form data including store name, checkboxes, and photos
Clicking Reset hides the PDF download button and returns to the initial form state
After reset, user can submit a new checklist and generate a new PDF

file_operations.description: Add a Reset button that appears alongside the Download PDF button when isPdfReady is true. When clicked, the Reset button should: clear the storeName field, reset all checklist item completion states to false, clear all photos from the photo Map state, set isPdfReady to false (hiding both buttons), and return the form to its initial empty state. Style the button using the NeumorphicButton component with secondary variant to differentiate it from the Download PDF button. After reset, the user should be able to fill out and submit a new checklist.
